title: 翠森の噤みと、嘘なき祭礼
author: 森閑 イオリ

en.title: The Silence of the Emerald Forest and the Festival Without Lies
en.premise: As a botanist, I journey to the secluded village of Kamonagi, surrounded by deep primary forest, to study rare alpine plants. There, on the night of an annual festival, I encounter a strange legend: the villagers cannot tell a single lie. It is not mere superstition, but a physiological constraint imposed by an unknown fungus that dwells in the forest. On the night when only truth is revealed, the quiet harmony of the forest begins to unravel.

zh.title: 翠森的沉默与无谎祭典
zh.premise: 作为一名植物学家，我前往被深邃原始森林包围的神凪村，研究稀有的高山植物。在一年一度的祭典之夜，我遇到一个奇怪的传说：村民们无法说出任何谎言。这并非单纯的迷信，而是森林中未知真菌所带来的生理限制。在只有真相被揭露的夜晚，静谧的森林和谐开始慢慢崩溃。
